chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mu'ammar ibn Khalad, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) saying: 'Worship is not the abundance of prayer and fasting; rather, worship is contemplation regarding the Command of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
ai.seo_question: What is the true definition of worship according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) elevates *tafakkur* (contemplation) as the essence of worship, distinguishing it from the mere volume of ritual acts like prayer and fasting. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *‘ilm* (knowledge) and intellectual depth as prerequisites for sincere *‘ibadah*, ensuring that physical acts are accompanied by conscious understanding of the Divine. Such a perspective guards against ritualism devoid of spiritual presence, aligning with the Quranic call to reflect upon creation.
